about: TFN OS: the firmware names that app packages can call (made by sdk/tools/abi_gen.py from the built-in apps and main/tfn_abi_extra.json; add-only inside one version). symbols: name -> the board kinds whose firmware has it. revs: the revision that added a name (none = 0). perms: the permission classes. need: name -> the class that an app needs for it.

background.text: CHECKS THE NETWORK IN THE BACKGROUND

bus.text: USE THE I2C AND SPI BUSES OF THE BOARD

espnow.text: SEND ESP-NOW MESSAGES TO BOARDS NEAR IT

events.text: GET THE EVENTS OF THE SYSTEM (WIFI, NETWORK)

gpio.text: USE THE PINS OF THE BOARD

hid.text: BE A BLUETOOTH KEYBOARD AND MOUSE FOR A COMPUTER

net.text: USE THE NETWORK AND THE INTERNET

nvs.text: READ AND WRITE THE SETTINGS STORE (ALSO THE WIFI PASSWORDS)

pwm.text: USE THE PWM OUTPUTS (THE SCREEN LIGHT TOO)

radio.rx.text: LISTENS TO THE RADIO (THE BOARD RESTARTS WITH NO WIFI)

secret.text: KEEPS A SECRET KEY ON THE BOARD

sound.alert.text: PLAYS AN ALARM ALSO WHEN THE SOUND IS OFF

wifi.config.text: READ THE WIFI SETTINGS (ALSO THE PASSWORD)

wifi.radio.text: CHANGE THE WIFI RADIO (CHANNEL, POWER, RAW PACKETS)
